limits: No participant used root explain, selected HAL, --explain or -E. These are entrance-choice observations, not participant performance/adherence validation of contextual explanation or a HAL/direct comparison.
The guide accurately advertises current Member-only primary admission and discourages feature-exercise/verification reads. Offered mechanisms are not required quotas.
New guide is 1845 B versus the preceding 1123/1132 B guides; source also differs (current main 3e3e45a4...). Historical cost differences are not causal effects or controlled population comparisons.
Two independent fresh agents per task; no randomization, causal or general behavior claim.
Live NuGet search populations are not frozen and package seeds differ. Both successful searches are bounded at forty and return the same version; candidate-set equality is not claimed.
Inspection stderr includes completion warnings/failures, not automatically companion guidance. Requested entrance does not prove admitted/emitted explanation.
The one rejected depth invocation did not return an inspected population; it remains a failed request in measured operations. Existing guidance already states its candidate limit.
API signatures establish declared receiver/type/library fields; workflow descriptions are inferred, not behavioral executions or documentation claims.
Cross-process time_ns values are not comparable. Use locked append ordering only. UTF-8 saved/replayed bytes are not latency, tokens, delivered context or production-transfer measurements.
